title: Backup inventory and schedule
description: Generated list of every backed-up data store (databases, object storage, issued documents, configuration, secrets metadata, source repositories) with frequency, retention, copy locations and the data class it serves; stores intentionally excluded are listed with the rebuild path.

title: Backup job outcome stream
description: Per-job success or failure, size, duration and digest, with an alert and control exception raised when an expected backup is missing.
notes: SOC2-027 treats a missing expected heartbeat as a control exception.

title: Backup immutability and separation configuration attestation
description: Automated read of backup vault configuration showing object-lock or equivalent retention mode, separate account or tenancy, separate credentials, and absence of delete permissions for production and agent identities.

title: Backup encryption and key recovery record
description: Encryption algorithm, key hierarchy, key custody (separate from production keys) and the dated result of recovering a backup key from escrow.

title: Restore test with integrity verification
description: Dated restore of each data class into an isolated environment, followed by hash-chain or signed-checkpoint verification, trial balances per fund and record counts compared with the source.

title: Deterministic replay equivalence test
description: Result of rebuilding projections and balances by replaying the append-only journal and comparing them with the live projections, including a check that no external effect was emitted during replay.

title: Backup expiry and destruction record
description: For each deletion request, tenant exit or retention expiry: which backups still contain the data, their expiry dates, legal holds applied and the destruction certificate issued.
